name: Amlodipine
description: A long-acting dihydropyridine calcium channel blocker approved for hypertension and chronic stable and vasospastic angina.

systems.note: Arterial smooth muscle relaxation lowering blood pressure and relieving angina; the labelled indications.
Extensively hepatically metabolised; transaminase elevation is reported.
Dose-dependent peripheral oedema is the characteristic labelled adverse effect.

monitors.why: Extensive hepatic metabolism with reported transaminase elevation.
